* **ACIT 2520 (Developing Web Applications):** Requires 50% in ACIT 1515 along with 50% in ACIT 1620.

cases.question: which course can I learn how to use terraform?
cases.standalone_question: Which BCIT course teaches how to use Terraform?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You can learn how to use Terraform in several BCIT courses, including **COMP 4964** (DevOps Engineering) and **ACIT 4640**. 

* **COMP 4964 (DevOps Engineering):** This course covers Terraform and Ansible around week 12 of the schedule, alongside other DevOps tools like Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines.
* **ACIT 4640:** Dedicated topics in this course include an introduction to Terraform syntax and commands (Week 4), Terraform modules and variables (Week 9), and managing Terraform state (Week 13). 
* **Computer Systems Technology Diploma (Cloud Computing Option):** Terraform is also taught as part of the industry-standard DevOps and infrastructure tools utilized in the Cloud Computing option.

Sources:

- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20261089230/
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-systems-technology-diploma-full-time-5500dipma/
